caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity of two models, labeled "Transformer" and "MoHD," under different sub-dimension settings. The x-axis is labeled "Numbers of Sub-Dims" and is plotted on a linear scale with specific numerical tick labels provided at irregularly spaced intervals of 16, 32, 64, 128, and 256. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 9.5 to 12.5, with tick marks and corresponding dashed horizontal grid lines appearing at regular intervals of 0.5. The "Transformer" model is represented by a dashed red line without markers; it maintains a constant, flat trajectory at a y-value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis range from 16 to 256. The "MoHD" model is depicted by a solid blue line with square markers, which begins at a y-value of approximately 10.4 at x=16. The MoHD line exhibits a steady upward trend, rising to roughly 10.5 at x=32 and 10.55 at x=64, reaching its peak at approximately 10.65 at x=128, before experiencing a minor decline to end at approximately 10.6 at x=256. A light blue shaded region highlights the space between the higher Transformer line and the lower MoHD line across the span of the data points.
